A '''Rebel cell''' was established on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lan Barell/Legends|Lan Barell]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Based in [[the Grill]] in [[Shulell City]], the cell maintained a soup kitchen and was active in the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] network. The cell was also charged with recruiting any refugees that could be of value to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], but many of those approached refused to fight since they felt safe on Lan Barell. One of the cell leaders was [[Felix Habel]], and the cell operated with the knowledge of the Lan Barell government, the [[Human-Qieg Guild]]. Under agreement with the Guild, no heavy weapons were to be stockpiled in the [[Lan system]] for fear of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] retaliation. However, several firebrands in the cell secretly established a [[Rebel weapons depot|weapons depot]] in the planet's [[Lowlands (Lan Barell)|Lowlands]].
